conservation_status.note_en: The current global assessment is Endangered with a decreasing population.
conservation_status.note_zh: 当前全球等级为濒危，种群趋势下降。

description.en: The Amazon river dolphin, or boto, is a flexible-necked freshwater whale of the Amazon and Orinoco systems. Echolocation, broad flippers and a long toothed rostrum help it hunt through turbid channels and seasonally flooded forest.
description.zh: 亚河豚又称波托，是生活在亚马逊河和奥里诺科河水系、颈部灵活的淡水鲸类。回声定位、宽大胸鳍和长而有齿的吻部帮助它在浑浊河道及季节性淹水森林中捕猎。

anatomy.en: Adults are roughly 2–2.5 m long; large males can exceed 180 kg and are larger than females. The long rostrum bears differentiated teeth, the neck vertebrae allow unusual turning, and the low dorsal ridge avoids a tall fin in tangled habitat.
anatomy.zh: 成体体长约2–2.5米；大型雄性可超过180千克，且大于雌性。长吻具有分化牙齿，颈椎允许异常灵活的转动，低矮背脊避免高背鳍在复杂生境中受阻。

ecology_and_behavior.en: Individuals usually occur alone or in small loose groups and eat diverse fish plus some crustaceans and turtles. During floods they enter inundated forests and use biosonar and flexible bodies among submerged trunks.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 个体通常独居或组成松散小群，取食多种鱼，也吃部分甲壳类和龟类。洪水期会进入淹水森林，利用生物声纳和灵活身体穿行水下树干之间。

habitat_and_distribution.en: The species occupies connected channels, tributaries, lakes and flooded forest in the Amazon and Orinoco basins; dams and rapids divide populations and taxonomic boundaries within Inia remain important.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 该物种利用亚马逊河与奥里诺科河流域相连的主河道、支流、湖泊和淹水森林；水坝和急流会分隔种群，亚河豚属内部的分类边界也很重要。

habitat.text_en: Endemic to the turbid waters of the Amazon and Orinoco river basins, including main channels, tributaries, lakes, and seasonally flooded forests (várzea and igapó).
habitat.text_zh: 特有于亚马逊河和奥里诺科河流域的浑浊水域，包括主要河道、支流、湖泊以及季节性泛滥的森林（várzea和igapó）。

range_review.comparison_en: The previous center, zoom and polygon coordinates are retained exactly. Authoritative text supports the broad distribution, but reusable authoritative boundary geometry was unavailable; the legacy polygon is labelled approximate, not verified.
range_review.comparison_zh: 原有中心点、缩放和多边形坐标完全保留。权威文字支持大致分布，但未获得可复用的权威边界几何；原多边形标为近似范围，而非已核实边界。

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Females usually bear 1 calf after roughly 11–12 months of gestation. Calves nurse for an extended period and remain close to mothers while learning seasonal river habitats; slow reproduction limits replacement of adults killed in fisheries.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 雌性妊娠约11–12个月后通常产下1头幼豚。幼豚长期哺乳并跟随母豚学习季节性河流生境；缓慢繁殖限制了对渔业死亡成体的补充。

detail.en: Unfused cervical vertebrae permit tighter turns around submerged trees than in most dolphins.
detail.zh: 未融合颈椎使其比多数海豚更能在水下树木间急转。

detail.en: Large paddle-like flippers provide control in shallow, obstructed water.
detail.zh: 桨状宽胸鳍可在浅水和障碍密集水域中精确操控。

detail.en: Echolocation reveals prey and obstacles where suspended sediment limits vision.
detail.zh: 悬浮泥沙限制视觉时，回声定位可探测猎物和障碍。

ecological_role.en: As a high-level freshwater predator, the boto links fish, crustacean and turtle food webs across main channels and floodplain forests; its condition also reflects river connectivity and fishing pressure.
ecological_role.zh: 作为高营养级淡水捕食者，亚河豚连接主河道与洪泛森林中的鱼、甲壳类和龟类食物网；其状况也反映河流连通性和捕捞压力。

threats.en: Entanglement and deliberate killing in fisheries, mercury, prey depletion, vessel traffic and dams that fragment rivers drive decline.
threats.zh: 渔具缠绕和故意捕杀、汞污染、猎物减少、船舶活动及切断河流的水坝推动种群下降。

actions.en: Reduce bycatch and deliberate killing, enforce fishery rules, protect connected flood pulses and channels, control pollution and monitor genetically distinct river populations.
actions.zh: 应减少兼捕和故意捕杀，执行渔业规定，保护连通洪峰与河道，控制污染，并监测遗传上不同的河流种群。

key_features.en: Robust river dolphin with a very long narrow rostrum, low dorsal ridge, broad flippers and gray to pink coloration that varies by age and condition.
key_features.zh: 体形粗壮的河豚，吻部很长而窄，背脊低矮，胸鳍宽，体色随年龄和状态由灰到粉红变化。

similar_species.en: Tucuxi are smaller, more conventionally dolphin-shaped and carry a triangular dorsal fin. Color alone is unreliable, and Inia taxonomy differs among river basins.
similar_species.zh: 土库海豚更小、体形更接近典型海豚，具有三角形背鳍。体色本身不可靠，且不同流域的亚河豚属分类存在差异。

communication_and_senses.en: Clicks drive echolocation; whistles and other calls support social contact. Touch and body orientation matter at close range in water where visibility may be only a short distance.
communication_and_senses.zh: 喀哒声用于回声定位；哨声等叫声维持社会联系。在能见度很短的水中，触碰和身体朝向对近距离交流也很重要。

seasonal_calendar.en: Rising water opens floodplain forest and disperses fish; falling water concentrates animals in channels and lakes. Males and females may use these seasonal habitats differently.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 涨水开放洪泛森林并分散鱼群；退水使动物集中到河道和湖泊。雌雄可能以不同方式利用这些季节性生境。

relationship_with_humans.en: The boto is central to Amazonian stories and tourism but is also caught accidentally or killed for bait. Responsible viewing avoids chasing, touching and feeding and follows local vessel limits.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 亚河豚在亚马逊故事和旅游中地位重要，却也会被误捕或被杀作诱饵。负责任观赏应避免追逐、触摸和投喂，并遵守当地船舶限制。

evolution.en: Inia represents an ancient freshwater cetacean lineage. Geographic barriers and molecular work have led to debate and revision over how many living Inia species should be recognized.
evolution.zh: 亚河豚属代表古老淡水鲸类谱系。地理屏障和分子研究引发了对现生亚河豚应承认多少物种的持续修订。

field_signs.en: A low rolling back, no tall dorsal fin, a long rostrum and pink-gray body may appear briefly at the surface. Splash color and folklore are insufficient; photographs should show profile and fin shape.
field_signs.zh: 水面可能短暂出现低缓背线、无高背鳍、长吻和粉灰身体。水花颜色和传说不足以鉴定；照片应显示侧面与鳍形。

text.en: Its neck can turn more freely than the necks of most oceanic dolphins.
text.zh: 它的颈部比多数海洋海豚转动更自由。

text.en: Flooded forest becomes seasonal hunting habitat rather than a barrier.
text.zh: 淹水森林会成为季节性狩猎生境，而非障碍。

text.en: Not every river dolphin in the Amazon is an Inia; tucuxi also use freshwater.
text.zh: 亚马逊河中并非每只河豚都是亚河豚；土库海豚也利用淡水。

content.en: Breathing air, nursing a single calf and using acoustic perception must all function within river currents, floods, nets and fragmented channels rather than an open ocean.
content.zh: 呼吸空气、哺育单胎幼豚和使用声学感知，都必须在河流流速、洪水、渔网和破碎河道中完成，而非开放海洋。
